name: Entity View Display Template Suggestions
description: Lets you configure Twig template suggestions based on entity view displays.
project_description:
This module aims to allow entity templates to get suggestions from the entity view display configuration. The goal is to allow to have generic templates not related to a view mode and to be able to configure if the view mode should use it or not.

 
 
 Features 
 Currently the module only allows to have a bare template suggestion.

 
 
 Post-Installation 
 After enabling the module, go on a view display configuration like "admin/structure/types/manage/page/display" and you will see a new configuration option.
